<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>Fractional frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by 3.5 using double-edge clocking.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">7</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="count">Count register to track clock cycles.</reg>
        <wire id="clk_div_int">Intermediate divided clock signal.</wire>
        <wire id="clk_div_delayed">Delayed version of the divided clock.</wire>
        <wire id="clk_div_advanced">Advanced version of the divided clock.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                count <= 0;
                clk_div_int <= 0;
                clk_div_delayed <= 0;
                clk_div_advanced <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (count == MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1) begin
                    count <= 0;
                end else begin
                    count <= count + 1;
                end
                
                if (count < MUL2_DIV_CLK / 2) begin
                    clk_div_int <= 1;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_int <= 0;
                end
                
                if (count < MUL2_DIV_CLK / 2) begin
                    clk_div_delayed <= 0;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_delayed <= 1;
                end
                
                if (count < MUL2_DIV_CLK / 2) begin
                    clk_div_advanced <= 1;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_advanced <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        clk_div <= clk_div_int | clk_div_delayed | clk_div_advanced;
    </implementation>
</module>
